title: Linux kernel AI analysis result
description: One result document per source chunk, with SHA-keyed analyses.

run_id.description: Run identity copied from the input chunk.

input_checksum.description: SHA-256 of the exact source chunk bytes.

input_schema_checksum.description: SHA-256 of the served input schema bytes.

output_schema_checksum.description: SHA-256 of this served output schema's exact bytes.

analysis_status.description: Complete requires every source commit; partial permits a subset.

total_commits.description: Number of commits in the input chunk.

results.description: Analyses keyed by full 40-character source commit SHA.

ai_is_security_fix.description: Commit fixes a security vulnerability according to available evidence.

ai_is_bug_fix.description: Commit fixes a functional bug; may also be a security fix.

ai_is_new_security_feature.description: Commit adds a security capability rather than repairing a vulnerability.

ai_categorisation_rationale.description: Short evidence-based rationale for the classifications.

ai_risks_if_not_backported.description: Product risks of omitting this backport; none must be used alone.

ai_impact_on_product.description: Expected impact on this product, not general upstream severity.

ai_backport_effort.description: Estimated engineering effort; not a cherry-pick test result.

ai_backport_effort_reason.description: Brief reason for the effort estimate including known dependencies.

ai_cve_ids.description: CVE IDs explicitly supported by the input; no inferred or invented identifiers.

ai_cve_probabilities.description: Estimated relevance percentages corresponding positionally to ai_cve_ids; empty if no CVEs.

ai_summary.description: Concise evidence and rationale for the recommendation.
